request.customer_message: I filed my car insurance claim three months ago after a collision on Highway 101. The incident report was filed on time, and I've provided all requested documentation. However, I haven't received any update on my claim status. When I call the support line, I'm put on hold for hours only to be told that my claim is still under review. This is unacceptable! I have medical bills piling up, and my car is still unfixed. I need someone in management to review this immediately. This is the worst customer service experience I've ever had with your company. I'm very frustrated and disappointed.
